lineage.reason: Paraphrases the well-known 'better, stronger, faster' catchphrase (The Six Million Dollar Man).
lineage.after: More torque, more yield, same handsome miner.

lineage.reason: Echoes the famous tagline 'this time it's personal'; otherwise a fine cocky self-mocking line.
lineage.before: Ow. Okay, that one was personal.
lineage.after: Ow. Putting that dent on corporate's tab.

lineage.reason: 'Come get some' is a well-known action catchphrase (Duke Nukem, Army of Darkness).
lineage.after: More tin cans? Fine. Drill bit's warm.

lineage.reason: 'Yippee-ki-yay' is the Die Hard catchphrase, a real film line.
lineage.before: Yippee-ki-yay, Kessler-Voss. Thanks for the ore.
lineage.after: Payload's aboard. Kessler-Voss can bill the wind.

lineage.reason: Paraphrases the catchphrase 'Mama needs a new pair of shoes'.
lineage.before: Jackpot! Mama needs a new gun.
lineage.after: Jackpot! My cut just got bigger.

lineage.reason: On a lost run it mocks the outcome of the player's performance rather than one of Rook's plans.
lineage.before: Well. That was a very expensive nap.
lineage.after: Well. Worse than the Pallas run. Barely.

lineage.reason: Glossy propaganda with a jokey 'doorstep' aimed at intruders on site, where the threat register must be cold bureaucracy; it also claims the Rigs' own console as a company product.
lineage.before: Kessler-Voss Smart Consoles: innovation, delivered straight to your doorstep!
lineage.after: Foreign device detected on claim network. Session logged for review.

lineage.reason: Cold bureaucratic register is right, but 'Form 27-B' echoes the famous Form 27B/6 from the film Brazil and is close to the vault example 'Notice 7-B'.
lineage.before: Unauthorized console retrieval will be logged under Form 27-B.
lineage.after: Unregistered console connection recorded. Network access will be invoiced.

lineage.reason: Calls intruders 'valued guests' with a cheerful 'Surprise!', a sarcastic joke toward threats.
lineage.before: Surprise! A Kessler-Voss Rewards Crate has arrived for valued guests!
lineage.after: Supply crate released in restricted sector. Unauthorized retrieval will be recorded.

lineage.reason: 'Compliance is mandatory' implicitly orders the player to stop, contradicting the objective.
lineage.before: Security response dispatched. Compliance is mandatory and appreciated.
lineage.after: Security response dispatched. Asset recovery in progress.

lineage.reason: Cheerful euphemism 'coming to meet you!' toward threats is a joke, not cold bureaucracy.
lineage.before: Kessler-Voss Safety Team is coming to meet you!
lineage.after: Claim security units routed to extraction irregularity.

lineage.reason: Sarcastic hospitality toward intruders is a joke; the company also frames the Rigs' shuttle as its own service.
lineage.before: Your premium departure experience awaits. Thank you for visiting!
lineage.after: Unregistered craft detected in claim airspace. Departure will be invoiced.

lineage.reason: Real Scarface line 'Say hello to my little friend', paraphrased, with no catalogue film named.
lineage.before: Say hello to my little friend, but louder.
lineage.after: Like in Lethal Weaponize: bigger bang, fewer witnesses.

lineage.reason: Real Dirty Harry line 'Go ahead, make my day', no catalogue film named.
lineage.before: Go ahead, make my day. Repeatedly.
lineage.after: Like in Speedbump: trigger first, questions later.

lineage.reason: Paraphrases the Terminator 2 catchphrase 'Hasta la vista, baby'.
lineage.after: Like in Point Brake: fresh mag, zero pause.

lineage.reason: Real Dirty Harry line 'Do you feel lucky, punk?', paraphrased.
lineage.before: Feeling lucky, punk? Because I do.
lineage.after: Like in Dirty Hairy: aim for the soft spot.

lineage.reason: 'That's gonna leave a mark' is a well-known catchphrase.
lineage.before: That one is gonna leave a mark, buddy.
lineage.after: Hit the weld seam. Robots hate that.

lineage.reason: Paraphrases the Terminator catchphrase 'I'll be back'.
lineage.before: I'll be back. Eventually. Sturdier, too.
lineage.after: More hull patch, less me leaking.

lineage.reason: Paraphrases the Predator line 'Get to the choppa'.
lineage.before: Get to the choppa, but I'm already there.
lineage.after: Like in Running Late Man: wrong place, but faster.
